User.title: User
User.description: Represents an authenticated user in Arohi AI and stores their profile, subscription status, unified memory, chat history, voice call logs, CBT mock test submissions, Gaming Arena stats, Arohi ONE state, and Mission 87 progress.

uid.description: Unique user ID from Firebase Authentication

profile.description: User profile details like phone, location, education, activeGoal, resumeUrl

enrolledCourses.description: List of courses user is enrolled in

completedModules.description: Dictionary of completed module IDs from skills/courses

checkedChecklist.description: Dictionary of checked career progress checklist IDs

arohiChats.description: User's past chat sessions with Arohi AI

arohiCalls.description: User's past voice call summaries with Arohi AI

mockTestHistory.description: Historical records of completed CBT mock exams and diagnostic evaluations

lastExamDate.description: ISO timestamp of the most recent exam completion

arenaStats.description: Arohi Exams & Gaming Arena progress including coins, gems, tournaments, badges, rank, and subject masteries

mission87Enrollment.description: Mission 87 cadet profile, track, milestones, blueprints, and verified earnings

businessOsData.description: Arohi ONE Business OS workspace state including company profile, CRM, invoices, inventory, and telemetry

isSubscribed.description: Whether the user has an active premium subscription

examPass.description: Active Arohi Exams Pass metadata and remaining test quota

freeExamAttemptsCount.description: Number of free mock test attempts consumed

diagnostics.description: ATS resume, mock interview, and business readiness diagnostic scores

activities.description: Audit trail of user actions across Arohi modules

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of last cloud synchronization

VoiceCallLog.title: VoiceCallLog
VoiceCallLog.description: Detailed transcription and career/business analysis generated from real-time live voice sessions.

uid.description: User ID of the caller or guest

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the call log creation

turns.description: List of conversational dialogue turns between caller and Arohi AI

analysis.description: AI-generated strategic summaries, action plans, priorities, and career-related flags

Partner.title: Partner
Partner.description: Represents an influencer, affiliate, or creator partner tracking student onboarding and 15% commissions.

referralCode.description: Unique uppercase referral code used by students

bankDetails.description: UPI ID and Bank payout details

PartnerConversion.title: PartnerConversion
PartnerConversion.description: Audit record of a student signup, subscription, or pass purchase referred by a partner.

partnerCode.description: Referral code of the credited partner

studentEmail.description: Masked email of the referred student

planName.description: Name of the purchased plan or pass

PartnerPayout.title: PartnerPayout
PartnerPayout.description: Payout withdrawal request and settlement record for an influencer or partner.

payoutMethod.description: Method of payment (UPI or Bank Transfer)

payoutDetails.description: Recipient UPI ID or Bank account details

utr.description: Bank UTR or payment reference number

/users/{userId}.description: Active user profiles containing career progress, bookmarks, chat history, exams, gaming arena stats, Arohi ONE, and Mission 87 progress.

/voice_call_logs/{logId}.description: Audit trails and rich career-intent dialogue logs for real-time live voice calls.

/partners/{partnerId}.description: Partner influencer account records and custom commission rates.

/partner_conversions/{conversionId}.description: Individual student conversion and 15% commission ledger entries.

/partner_payouts/{payoutId}.description: Partner withdrawal requests and payout settlements.
